items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: Red Kelly was off the band at that time.

ctx.x: Silence. And she says, “Why would you want to leave the job that you’ve always wanted that you love, and you’re doing exactly what you want to do? Why would you do that? And I said, “I just think it’s time for me to come home.” And she says, “Well that’s going to be your decision, okay? But let me tell you something, don’t you ever mention to me that I made you leave Harry James. That’s your decision and that’s your decision alone.” So I went and knocked on Harry’s door and I said, “Harry, I think it’s time I go…

and don’t give them to anybody else. But you can have whatever I’ve got.” Now that’s a pretty — which they sent me stuff that I still have today and now I have the whole library. But so that was pretty interesting. And then I went back to the band three or four times. And you know like Corky would be playing and he’d be having a problem with the trumpet section, Harry’d go, “Why don’t you get a hold of Fred and see if he can come out and help us out for three or four days” you know. And then when Harry ever came…
